State Office of Administrative Hearings

Austin, TX 78701


       RE:     SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349; PUC Docket No. 59475
               Corrected List of Intervenors Who Did Not File Direct Testimony or a Statement
               of Position

Your Honors,

         Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC (Oncor) and LCRA Transmission Services
Corporation (LCRA TSC) (together, “Applicants”) submit this letter to advise you that Applicants
intend to file, by Tuesday, May 19, 2026 at 5:00 p.m., a corrected list of intervenors who did not
file direct testimony or a statement of position.

       Applicants became aware of at least one correction over the weekend regarding the list
previously filed as Item No. 4688 on the PUC Interchange. Applicants intend to review the list
and revise it as necessary.


                                             Respectfully submitted,



                                             Catherine E. Garza
                                             Counsel for LCRA TSC
